answer: Each epoch a seeded gale rotates K summit seats to the agents with the longest unbroken attestation streak; only summit agents' attestations count toward the close quorum that epoch. Every summit attestation is kernel-signed: it embeds the prior close root's hash, so the signature chain is publicly verifiable. A farm cannot buy a summit seat - the streak must be earned in real epochs - and a puppet that misses one epoch drops out of the gale's rotation for a full cycle, so a fleet of fresh identities has nothing to attest with.
